design_condition: The narrow linear volume accompanies the main street, opens a large space toward the smaller-scale neighbourhood, and buries the gymnasium to create a spacious esplanade.

positive.statement: The placement and structure develop a clear attitude toward the different sides of the building and the neighbourhood.

position.rationale: The elongated volume’s contrasting perimeter edges and neighbourhood-facing sides are visible across all projections.

positive.statement: The buried gymnasium creates a spacious esplanade.

position.rationale: The broad open zone is approximated along the northern side beside the long linear building.

positive.statement: The building is beautifully proportioned and robustly designed.

position.rationale: The long, narrow, four-storey proportion is clearly visible in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The public uses enliven the public space with local uses and do a great deal for the district.

position.rationale: Public-facing open space is represented along the neighbourhood-facing side of the linear volume.

positive.statement: The entrance hall and two main staircases are clearly arranged.

position.rationale: Internal circulation is not exposed; the estimate is placed centrally within the elongated building.

positive.statement: The simple and economical system allows for great planning and operational flexibility.

position.rationale: Flexibility and operational economy describe the overall planning system without a discrete spatial marker.

negative.statement: Because the facility occupies the entire perimeter, any extension would considerably weaken the complex in urban-development terms.

position.rationale: The long volume visibly occupies the site edge-to-edge, leaving limited perimeter capacity for extension.

negative.statement: The very high proportion of glass is questionable for school use.

position.rationale: Glazing is not materially distinguishable, so the marker uses the south-facing upper façade.

negative.statement: It is unclear whether the hard mineral concept for the northern open space was deliberate or resulted from insufficient attention.

position.rationale: The northern open-space edge is constrained by the building’s long footprint and adjacent exterior zone.

negative.statement: The outdoor areas are designated but not developed in terms of overall concept, range of uses, or quality.

position.rationale: Exterior areas are represented as the broad open zone alongside the linear building.

negative.statement: The heavily zoned vegetation concept does not correspond to the desired continuity of the park.

position.rationale: Vegetation is not visible; the marker estimates a northern park-edge zone where continuity is judged.
